reader_summary.overview: Celsius trades at ~20x earnings while growing ~18% a year, cheaper than Monster (~34x) and even Coke (~25x) despite faster growth. The Pershing Square Challenge third-place team makes the long case for $CELH: the market is sleeping on the Alani Nu acquisition. Andrew pushes back hard on the Costco/Kirkland private-label threat, the heavy reliance on Pepsi distribution.
